request: a bento box-inspired collapsible UI menu component for a fictional coffee company site
thesis: A menu that behaves like a bento lunchbox: a lid that opens to reveal a tidy mosaic of compartments of unequal size, each holding one thing, with a calm tray of rounded cells and one hero cell.
job: see a closed trigger/lid on the site header and understand it is the menu
open it (click, tap, Enter/Space) and watch compartments reveal
scan the compartments: shop beans, subscriptions, brew guides, cafes, story, cart
hover/focus a cell to get feedback; open a cell's sub-detail or expand it
pick a destination (state shows which is selected/active)
collapse again (button, Esc, outside click, pick an item) and focus returns to trigger
use on phone: single or two-column grid, big touch targets

principles: state is visible: open/closed, active item
one obvious way in, many ways out
steps: closed -> open -> item focused -> item chosen -> closed
tricks: aria-expanded on trigger, hidden panel via grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr for animatable height
tests: open, press Esc, focus is back on trigger

principles: unequal cells on a shared grid, equal gaps
steps: define grid 4 cols x 3 rows with spans
assign hero, wide, tall, small cells
tricks: each cell a distinct tint of the same palette family
tests: squint: do you see a tray with a hero?
no cell has orphan empty space

principles: stagger reveals compartment by compartment like opening lids
button semantics, visible focus ring, contrast 4.5:1
one state object, render from state
CSS grid, custom properties, no libraries
tricks: inert on closed panel so it is not tabbable

expectations: items are links/buttons that do something

kinds.name: lid-lift tray
kinds.what: header button opens a bento tray under it; cells stagger in

kinds.name: accordion bento
kinds.what: each cell itself expands in place to reveal sub-links

kinds.name: full-screen sheet
kinds.what: menu takes the viewport as a bento mosaic

descriptions: invented name e.g. Ember & Oak Coffee Roasters

tokens.palette: espresso #2b1d16, crema #f3e6d3, latte #d9b99b, terracotta #c8553d, moss #5b6b4a, cream paper #fbf5ec

behaviors: choosing a cell marks it active and shows it in a status line

anti_keywords.instead: visibly unequal compartment tray with a hero cell

anti_keywords.not: all cells same size and colour
anti_keywords.instead: varied spans, tints from one family, one dark cell for contrast
real state: open, active item, cart count, status line
add terracotta and moss accents, crema highlights
system serif for display, system sans for UI, inline SVG/CSS art

checks: keyboard-only: Tab to trigger, Enter opens, arrows move between cells, Esc closes and refocuses trigger
click a cell: active state and status line change
phone width: no horizontal scroll, targets >= 44px
